source.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over source files sorted by UTF-8 path bytes; for each file append u64 big-endian path byte length, path bytes, u64 big-endian blob byte length, exact git blob bytes. No separators or newline conversion.
limitations: Documentation snapshot delta, not proof of runtime behavior or first API introduction.
Only immediate *Documentation.lua files in Blizzard_APIDocumentationGenerated; excludes FrameXML helpers, CVars and GlobalStrings not represented there.
Documentation prose is ignored recursively; Enum/Constants references and their addition/subtraction remain symbolic strings; no numeric resolution is inferred.
Two endpoints only; intermediate additions/removals are not observable.
source.method: Semantic comparison of generated Blizzard API documentation evaluated in isolated rilua VMs
